test_title: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 08 Aug, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: The average runs scored by a batsman in 23 matches is 42. In the next 10 matches, the batsman scored an average of 15 runs. Find his average runs scored (rounded off to two decimal places) in all the 33 matches.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Assumed overall average = 42 (from the first 23 matches)

Deviation of the next 10 matches = 15 − 42 = −27

Total deviation = 10 × (−27) = −270

Net change in average = −270 ÷ 33 ≈ −8.18

Overall Average = 42 − 8.18 = 33.82

**∴ The correct answer is 33.82 runs.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Average runs of 23 matches = 42

Average runs of next 10 matches = 15

**Formula Used:**

Combined Average = (n₁x₁ + n₂x₂) ÷ (n₁ + n₂)

 
 23 Matches
 Avg: 42
 
 
 10 Matches
 Avg: 15
 
 

 Total 33 Matches
 Overall Avg = ?

**Calculations:**

⇒ Total runs in first 23 matches = 23 × 42 = 966

⇒ Total runs in next 10 matches = 10 × 15 = 150

⇒ Total runs in all 33 matches = 966 + 150 = 1116

⇒ Combined Average = 1116 ÷ 33

⇒ Combined Average = 372 ÷ 11 = 33.8181...

⇒ Rounding off to two decimal places, the average is 33.82.

**∴ The correct answer is 33.82 runs.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Weighted Average

Used when different groups have different sizes. The formula is Aw = (n₁A₁ + n₂A₂) ÷ (n₁ + n₂).

Deviation Method for Averages

An assumed average is taken and the net deviation of all values from this assumed average is calculated. The true average is Assumed Average + (Net Deviation ÷ Total Count).

Combined Average

It represents the single average value of two or more independent groups combined together, perfectly preserving the total sum of all values across the groups.
